shared_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready raster PNG icon for a medieval village-building game's parchment user interface.
Create ONE isolated icon, centered on a square canvas, with a genuinely transparent background.
Art direction: polished hand-painted fantasy item illustration, dark sepia ink contours with subtly uneven hand-drawn edges, rich restrained gouache shading, warm soft highlights from the upper left, convincing material texture and gentle volume. This is finished game artwork with careful craftsmanship. Earthy ochre, leather brown, warm steel gray, cream, terracotta red and moss green palette. Readable bold silhouette, chunky important details and excellent contrast on pale parchment. Make it readable at 28px and 40px. Keep secondary details understated.
Framing: object fills approximately 82 percent of the square's longest dimension, evenly centered, all parts visible with clean transparent padding around the full silhouette. No cropped tips.
Background: real alpha transparency everywhere outside the object, including any holes; no checkerboard drawn into the image, no white or paper rectangle.
Constraints: no scene, no floor, no pedestal, no cast shadow detached from the object, no enclosing badge or decorative frame, no labels, no watermark. Crisp painted edges and deliberate brushwork, no blurry fuzzy halo.

subjects.sword: A single sturdy medieval short sword pointing diagonally upward to the right. Broad silver steel blade with a bright edge and one restrained reflection, antique brass crossguard and pommel, dark brown wrapped leather grip. Strong heroic proportions, complete blade and grip visible.
subjects.hammer: A single heavy builder's hammer tilted diagonally, with a worn forged-steel rectangular head, slightly rounded striking face, small brass ferrule, and substantial dark honey-brown wooden handle wrapped near the grip. Beautiful material shading; instantly identifiable as a construction hammer.
subjects.army: A single substantial medieval infantry helmet, front three-quarter view, warm silver-gray forged iron with a large dark T-shaped visor opening, a short deep terracotta-red crest, subtle rivets and a brown leather neck guard. No human face and no shoulders. Strong broad silhouette, few bold details.
subjects.gold: A compact stack of three thick golden coins with one larger upright gold coin leaning against it, facing three-quarter toward the viewer. The upright coin has a simple embossed sun symbol, no text or numbers. Rich warm ochre gold, distinct bright rims and darker grooves. Unified compact silhouette, not scattered coins.
subjects.bread: A single plump small oval loaf of crusty golden-brown bread viewed from a gentle three-quarter angle. Three broad diagonal cuts expose soft pale cream crumb. Warm baked ochre highlights, deep toasted brown on the underside, hand-painted crust. Full loaf only, no plate, no flour pile.
subjects.gem: A single large bright moss-green emerald crystal with a clearly cut jewel silhouette, front three-quarter view. Thick broad polygon facets, luminous light green faces at the upper left, deep forest-green shadow facets, one crisp pale glint. Entire gem is solid colored; clean outline, no floating sparkles or magical glow cloud.
subjects.shield: A broad medieval wooden kite shield with a rich muted terracotta-red painted face, thick antique brass rim and simple chunky central brass chevron. Subtle timber texture beneath worn paint, four large rivets, warm upper-left highlights. Nearly front view with a small three-quarter angle, strong complete silhouette.
subjects.village: A single compact medieval stone cottage for a village navigation icon, three-quarter isometric view. Cream stone walls, a steep chunky terracotta tile roof, one round wooden door and one warm golden-lit window. Charming confident fantasy craftsmanship. No village scenery, no terrain patch, no trees, no smoke, no sky. The cottage itself alone forms a broad instantly readable silhouette.
subjects.flag: One medieval clan banner with a short sturdy wooden pole and brass finial, a broad gently waving deep terracotta-red cloth flag with a simple bold gold shield emblem. The cloth occupies most of the icon's width; pole and cloth fully visible. Rich cloth folds with broad readable shading, no lettering or heraldic micro-details.
subjects.shop: A single compact bulging honey-brown leather coin pouch tied at its neck with a dark cord, with two chunky gold coins visibly peeking out of the open top. Soft worn leather, broad warm painted highlights, dark stitched seam, simple expressive silhouette. No coins scattered on the ground.
subjects.mail: A single closed cream parchment envelope, front three-quarter view, with folded triangular flap and a prominent deep terracotta-red wax seal in its center. Thick warm parchment edges, subtle paper fibers, rich glossy painted wax highlights, a simple impressed star on the seal. No letters, no address, no stamp, no background paper.
subjects.gear: A single thick medieval forged-steel cogwheel with exactly eight bold broad teeth and a large circular hole through the center. Warm gray metal, small antique-brass bevels, few dark patina marks, slight three-quarter view. Broad chunky silhouette so it remains instantly recognizable as settings at 28 pixels. The center hole must also be truly transparent.
subjects.info: A single small open cream parchment scroll with curled top and bottom edges, as an information icon. One very large dark sepia lowercase letter 'i' painted in the center, with a clearly separate round dot above its stem. The letter is the only text, exactly lowercase i. Warm parchment shading, rolled edge thickness, no seal, no extra symbols, no frame. Bold i must remain readable at 28 pixels.
subjects.move: A single four-direction move emblem, formed from four broad warm-gray forged-steel arrowheads pointing up, down, left, right, meeting at one small square brass center hub. All four directions equally strong, symmetric and instantly readable. Hand-painted steel shading and sepia ink edge; an isolated cross-shaped object, no background badge, no circular enclosing frame.
subjects.close: One bold X-shaped cancel icon made of two thick terracotta-red painted wooden bars crossed diagonally. Short chunky proportions, rounded worn corners, subtle wood grain and broad warm highlight, dark sepia contours. Instantly readable X silhouette, no frame, no background and no other object.
subjects.check: One bold green checkmark-shaped confirmation emblem made of a thick moss-green painted carved wooden piece. Short lower-left stroke and a longer upward-right stroke, clear unmistakable checkmark. Rounded worn edges, subtle wood grain, soft light-green upper-left highlights and dark sepia contours. No badge, no frame, no background.
subjects.arrow: A single bold broad upward-pointing upgrade arrow emblem made of warm steel with an antique brass bevel. Symmetric pointed triangular arrowhead and thick short vertical stem. Bright upper-left plane and darker lower-right metal shading, a few careful painted patina marks, crisp dark sepia edges. Unmistakable upward arrow, no frame, no background, no extra symbols.
